membership.grouping: one fixed partition of original regime labels within each compatible block context
membership.intervals: nonempty contiguous intervals of each group's ordered original period buckets
membership.projection_policy: one globally coherent original-cell projection policy fixed before grouping

block.axis_union: a shared axis name must refer to the same original or declared-derived domain identity

source_dispatch.economic_nodes: retain original nodes and incidence laws; sharing an allocation block does not identify information sets or decision makers
source_dispatch.terminal: preserve the terminal classification, current payoff and feasible choices separately for every source cell; terminal cells acquire no continuation from living members of the block

preservation.unresolved_original_semantics: report unresolved; do not promote a structural cost candidate to an adoptable economic rewrite
